extDescription.message: Filters short and low-content praise comments on YouTube; supports large local lists, URL/file lists, optional reply filtering, badge counter, global counter, collapse mode and Pause/Resume.

privacyIntro.message: Filtering runs locally in your browser. Comment text is not sent to any service.

languageDesc.message: Automatic follows Chromium UI language. Polish is used for Polish Chromium; English is used for other languages.

languageImmediate.message: Changing the language takes effect immediately.

hideShort.message: Hide comments that are too short

hideShortDesc.message: Unicode characters are counted after trimming leading and trailing whitespace.

filterPraiseDesc.message: A comment is filtered after reaching the configured number of independent matches from the word and phrase lists.

praiseThreshold.message: Minimum praise matches required to hide

thresholdHint.message: The threshold is literal: at 1, one independent list match is enough to hide a comment; at 2, two are required, and so on. The slider covers 1–15; the number field can be set manually up to 999.

mainPraiseList.message: Main praise word/phrase list — one rule per line

localStorageHint.message: The list is stored locally, so it is not subject to the 8 KB per-item sync-storage limit.

readyListsDesc.message: Add text lists by URL or load .txt files. They are merged with the main list while filtering.

externalUrlsLabel.message: External list URLs — one URL per line

externalUrlsPlaceholder.message:
https://example.org/youtube-praise-list.txt
# lines beginning with # or ! are ignored

listFormatHint.message: List format is simple: one phrase or rule per line, * marks a word stem, and lines beginning with # or ! are comments. URL lists are updated manually with the button above; if downloading fails, the last valid cached copy remains active.

listHelpSummary.message: How do I create phrase and keyword lists?

listHelpP1.message: Each line is a separate trigger. It can be one word, e.g. super, or a phrase, e.g. great job.

listHelpP2.message: An asterisk * at the end of a word matches the beginning of that word. For example, amaz* matches amazing, amazingly, etc. It also works inside phrases. A plain entry such as super still means a whole word and will not match supermarket.

listHelpP3.message: Matching is case-insensitive and ignores Polish diacritics. Lines starting with # or ! are ignored, as are section headers in square brackets such as [My list].

listHelpP4.message: The threshold defines how many independent list matches are required to hide a comment. At threshold 1, one detected word or phrase is enough; at threshold 3, at least three independent matches are required. Overlapping rules are not double-counted — for example, with great* and great* video, “great video” counts as one longer match.

listHelpP5.message: The slider provides quick values from 1 to 15. The number field can set a larger threshold manually (up to 999). If you enter 20, the slider remains visually at 15 but the saved and used threshold is 20.

listHelpP6.message: Prefer stems with at least 4–5 letters. Very short stems can match many unrelated words and create false positives.

defaultListHint.message: The default list is broad and tuned for threshold 2: it contains more than 800 Polish and English signals of praise, gratitude, loyalty, “easy to listen/watch” phrases, praise of expertise/quality, and wildcard stems. Short comments with only one signal are still handled by the minimum-length filter.

filterRepliesDesc.message: Off by default. When enabled, expanded replies are filtered using the same rules as top-level comments.

filterRepliesHint.message: When disabled, the extension ignores replies even after you expand them. This does not affect filtering of the parent comment.

collapseFilteredDesc.message: Instead of removing a filtered comment from view, shows a compact bar with a “Show comment” button. Applies to the length and praise filters.

collapseHelpP1.message: This option does not detect story spoilers. It only changes how comments already matched by the minimum-length or praise filter are presented.

collapseHelpP2.message: When disabled, a filtered comment disappears. When enabled, a small bar remains in its place with the reason and a “Show comment” button.

collapseHelpP3.message: After revealing the comment, the button changes to “Collapse comment”, so it can be shown and hidden repeatedly, similar to spoiler blocks on forums.

pauseDisabledHint.message: The Pause button does not change the master switch. Enable the extension in Settings.

pausePausedHint.message: Comments are currently shown without filtering. Click to resume.

pauseActiveHint.message: Click to immediately show all filtered comments.

disabledTitle.message: The extension is disabled in settings

globalBlockedTitle.message: Total comments filtered by CommentBlock since counting began

summaryMasterOff.message: The extension master switch is off.

summaryPaused.message: Pause does not change filter settings — they return to their previous state when resumed.

notDownloadedYet.message: This list has not been downloaded yet.

savedOk.message: Saved. Large lists are stored locally without the 8 KB per-item limit.

resetOk.message: Default settings restored and additional lists removed.

permissionDenied.message: Access to external-list domains was not granted.

updatedListsWithErrors.message: Updated {0}; errors: {1}. Previous cached copies were kept when available.
